## Featured Projects

- [Garden Party Pinball](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#project-garden-party-pinball): Status: In progress. I'm building a full-size homebrew pinball machine around FAST control hardware and Mission Pinball Framework. I designed and assembled the cabinet, playfield mechanisms, control board, wiring, and game logic. The machine currently powers up with the playfield installed while I rework the cabinet fit and final geometry. Published media: 2.
- [VividGrasp AI-Vision Robotics Arm](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#project-vividgrasp-ai-vision-robotics-arm): Status: Completed team project. A ten-person Stanford AI4ALL project combining computer vision, inverse kinematics, and PyBullet simulation to move a robotic arm toward recognized objects. My contribution: I led CAD, modeled the arm in SolidWorks, prepared its URDF files, and worked with a teammate on a physical prototype. ([source](https://github.com/LenekyRadish/VividGrasp)). Published media: 4.
- [Smart Self-Watering Pot / Smart Planter PCB](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#project-smart-self-watering-pot): Status: Prototype in progress. I designed and assembled an ESP32-based controller for a self-watering planter. The fabricated PCB reads soil moisture, controls a water pump, and integrates display and physical input hardware. I also designed the planter, reservoir, and electronics layout in SolidWorks. Published media: 4; interactive 3D models: 1.
- [Subpix](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#project-subpix): I built Subpix, an open-source desktop editor for drawing with individual RGB subpixels. It reads and validates .subpix JSON files, exports PNG images, and ships as a packaged Windows application built with Electron, React, TypeScript, and Vite. ([Open app](https://subpix-editor.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/Subpix)). Published media: 2.

## More Work

- [AgentDeck](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#more-work): I built AgentDeck to turn an old phone or tablet into a dedicated touchscreen controller for AI coding agents. A lightweight desktop host serves the interface over the local network, allowing spare hardware to replace an expensive single-purpose control deck. ([source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/agentdeck)). Published media: 1.
- [Check-ins](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#more-work): I built Check-ins, a local-first web app for recurring work and study tasks. It tracks target and maximum gaps, flags items that are due or overdue, and keeps a completion history without requiring an account. ([project](https://check-ins-zeta.vercel.app/), [source](https://github.com/Chrissyuh/check-ins)). Published media: 1.
- [VEX Robotics Builds](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#more-work): I built VEX robots at TETC to practice gearing, drivetrain layout, shaft spacing, and mechanical packaging. Published media: 0.
- [MIDI Practice Tool](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#more-work): A small Python tool for keyboard practice, soundfonts, pedals, and control mapping. Published media: 0.
- [Desmos 3D Solar System](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#more-work): An interactive 3D orbit scene built in Desmos to experiment with surfaces, motion, and performance limits. ([project](https://www.desmos.com/3d/qcjp33t4ij)). Published media: 0.
- [TinyGPT Experiments](https://chrisaheskett.vercel.app/#more-work): Small next-token-model experiments used to study training behavior and instruction behavior. Published media: 0.
